content: iOS simulator automation on CI is chronically flaky: patrol issue #2291 documents extremely flaky iOS Simulator e2e on GitHub Actions; actions/runner-images #9591 documents simulators failing to launch after Xcode updates breaking Detox runs; fastlane freezes on run script. idb (facebook/idb) is the standard automation CLI but adds companion/versioning complexity (askui/idb-mcp wraps it). Practical mitigations: pinned Xcode + runner images, explicit simulator boot wait with readiness checks, warm-boot reuse, retry-on-boot-failure, and treating boot/screenshot failures as infrastructure flakes distinct from app bugs.
